title: Change makes room for an ending
meaning: Flexible action motivated by a change of perspective can accompany an emotional farewell to an earlier form of shared experience.
text: The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of this Energy Field appears through changing shared actions when circumstances turn. The Hanged Man in energy connects motivation with suspending a habitual approach and allowing a different view of events. Death in emotions indicates the experience of an earlier form ending. Practical resourcefulness need not bring immediate lightness: reconsidering your perspective may let you feel more clearly that a familiar phase has finished, even while the shared activity continues in another way.

For example, the room where you have rehearsed together is no longer available. You change to meetings at home, but first set aside the familiar programme and discuss what the old place meant. Sadness emerges about the ending of a particular chapter. **We can continue together while still saying goodbye to how things used to be.** The new format does not have to replace immediately the emotional value of the old room and the rhythm that developed there.

A difficulty appears if suspension becomes a way to remain indefinitely at the threshold of change. The recognised ending then finds no expression in action, although conditions have already altered. Another possibility is to forbid regret for the sake of the new format. The Hanged Man requires no prolonged waiting, and Death does not predict the end of the union. The focus is an emotional response to one particular form of shared experience ending.
